_about.title: Power curves: winrate by game duration, Ancient-Divine, carry pool
_about.method: OpenDota SQL explorer, table public_matches, avg_rank_tier 60-79, duration >= 10 min. One query per hero: games and wins per 5-minute duration bucket. wr_shrunk = (wins + prior*overall)/(games + prior), prior = 500 games at the hero's own overall winrate. early_index = pooled shrunk winrate of games under 30 min minus overall; mid_index = 30-40 min; late_index = over 40 min; swing = late - early. curve_type: mid-game if the 30-40 window beats both ends by >= 1.5pp, else swing >= +4pp late scaler, <= -4pp early tempo, else flat.
_about.caveat: Duration is an OUTCOME, not a cause: stomps end early, so heroes that win stomps look 'early'. No position info: a mid TA/SF counts like a pos-1 one.
